description: This Java source file implements the MockDoorLockCluster class, providing a mock representation of a Zigbee door lock cluster for testing or simulation purposes. It defines attributes, command handlers (e.g., lock, unlock, set PIN), and maintains internal state such as lock status, PIN list, tampering, and alarms.

classes.name: MockDoorLockCluster
classes.description: A mock implementation of a Zigbee door lock cluster used for testing, with support for attributes, command handling, and internal lock state management.

classes.name: PinEntry
classes.description: Represents a PIN code entry with associated user ID, status, type, and PIN string.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Handles lock, unlock, PIN set, and clear all PIN commands.

methods.name: getAttributeData
methods.description: Returns data for requested attributes based on the internal state.

methods.name: setAttributeData
methods.description: Sets attribute data based on incoming attribute reports.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Returns whether the lock is currently engaged.

methods.name: setLocked
methods.description: Updates the lock state and triggers appropriate events.

methods.name: isTampered
methods.description: Returns whether tampering has been detected.

methods.name: setTampered
methods.description: Sets tampering status and triggers an alarm event if tampered.

methods.name: addPin
methods.description: Adds a PIN entry for a specific user.

methods.name: getPinCount
methods.description: Returns the number of PINs stored.

methods.name: getPins
methods.description: Returns a collection of all PIN entries.

methods.name: setAutoRelockTime
methods.description: Sets auto-relock time and reports the change.

calls: new AttributeReportEvent(getEui64(), getEndpointId(), getClusterId(), ATTRIBUTE_AUTO_RELOCK_TIME, DataType.UINT32, payload).send()
